free_tier.stated: No free tier — three paid plans: 'S | 200 GiB | $0.027/hour | ~$19.71/month', 'M | 600 GiB | $0.0613/hour | ~$44.749/month', 'L | 5 TiB | $0.291/hour | ~$212.43/month'.

egress.terms: Egress is genuinely unlimited and free — 'Traffic is unlimited, no matter what its destination' and 'Inbound/outbound traffic and maintenance are also included in the price' — but the storage is a flat monthly subscription, so the free-egress advantage is unusable without paying.

tooling: Harbor API + docker/skopeo/ORAS; Harbor's own replication for chaining registries.
chaining: None free. The $200 trial credit is a trial, not a free tier.
limits_note: 200 GiB (S) / 600 GiB (M) / 5 TiB (L) per registry; 15/45/90 concurrent connections ('Most client software is configured to use five simultaneous http connections').
reliability_note: Enterprise-grade Harbor with SLA tiers (99.9%/99.99%); irrelevant here because entry price is ~$20/month.
